introduction: Oklahoma energy assistance has scheduled enrollment periods. Check OKDHSLive before applying; a separate telephone route handles qualifying life-threatening crises year-round.
description: Oklahoma energy assistance has scheduled enrollment periods. Check OKDHSLive before applying; a separate telephone route handles qualifying life-threatening crises year-round.

sections.who: The state assesses income, household size and responsibility for energy costs. People sharing one meter apply together.
sections.get: Programs support heating, cooling and qualifying energy emergencies. Funding and the approved component determine assistance.
sections.docs:
• Household income and members.
  • Energy account and responsibility for the bill.
  • Crisis notices and any medical verification requested.
sections.apply:
1. Check current enrollment

    Use the agency guidance and OKDHSLive.

  2. Explain a life-threatening crisis

    Call 405-522-5050 and select energy assistance; do not rely on a routine seasonal application.

  3. Supply verification

    Match records to the agency request and keep your submission confirmation.
sections.after: Follow case notices and contact the utility about its own arrangements while assistance is pending.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Energy components and current intake. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is ordinary cooling assistance an emergency service?
No. The agency distinguishes routine seasonal help from crisis assistance.
Can I receive the same component from the state and a tribal program?
The state prohibits duplicate assistance for the same component in the same federal fiscal year.
The agency provides a year-round telephone route for qualifying life-threatening crises.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
